responsibility: Implements the second-phase resolver for Rust items after top-level names have been collected. This file resolves trait items, impl items, use-related helpers, functions, constants, extern items, and other item internals by entering item scopes, resolving generic parameters, self parameters, where clauses, types, patterns, and optional bodies, and by recording canonical paths and emitting duplicate-definition or lookup diagnostics as item contents are bound to previously declared names.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable item-resolution logic for the item resolver classes declared in the header, including traversal of trait items, impl items, extern items, use helpers, scope setup, canonical-path recording, and even selftests for use-tree flattening. Unlike the matching header, this file performs the second-phase resolution work instead of merely declaring the resolver classes.
